text:
loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

transforms:
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.resolve_landoscript_keyed_by:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    worker-type: lando
    worker:
        implementation: scriptworker-lando

        # Match Firefox behavior of only landing on beta when the tree is closed
        dontbuild:
            by-project:
                comm-(central|beta|release|esr140): false
                default: true
        ignore-closed-tree:
            by-project:
                comm-(central|beta|release|esr140): false
                default: true
        lando-repo:
            by-project:
                comm-central: thunderbird-desktop-main
                comm-beta: thunderbird-desktop-beta
                comm-release: thunderbird-desktop-release
                comm-esr140: thunderbird-desktop-esr140
                try-comm-central:
                    by-release-type:
                        beta: staging-thunderbird-beta
                        release: staging-thunderbird-release
                        esr140: staging-thunderbird-esr140
                        default: ""
                default: ""
        actions:
            by-release-type:
                # Whenever the the non-default config changes, make sure to make
                #     the corresponding change in merge-automation/kind.yml
                (beta|release|esr140):
                    - l10n-bump:
                          - name: Thunderbird l10n changesets
                            path: mail/locales/l10n-changesets.json
                            l10n-repo-url: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-l10n
                            l10n-repo-target-branch: main
title: Lando destination mapping: taskcluster/kinds/l10n-bump/kind.yml:5
